title: Rogues Gallery
paragraphs: Private-eye drama featuring Richard Rogue, a tough detective whose cases often take an unusual turn after he is knocked unconscious and consults his wisecracking alter ego, Eugor, on 'Cloud Eight.'

Hard-boiled private-eye series centered on Richard Rogue and his knockout-induced alter ego Eugor. Surviving collector numbering and specialist logs disagree on several program numbers/dates; those conflicts are represented rather than normalized away.

The run breaks into several distinct periods: Mutual Dick Powell run (June 23, 1945 to June 13, 1946) on [[org|org.09b709d4bde5c263|Mutual Broadcasting System]], NBC Dick Powell summer run (June 23, 1946 to September 22, 1946) on [[org|org.f2f0561f0ce2ddc5|NBC Radio Network]], and NBC Barry Sullivan summer run (June 8, 1947 to August 31, 1947) on [[org|org.f2f0561f0ce2ddc5|NBC Radio Network]].

Names that turn up again and again in the surviving run include [[person|dick-powell|Dick Powell]] (performer), Peter Leeds (performer), Dee Englebach (director and producer), Leith Stevens (composer and conductor), Ray Buffum (writer), Jim Doyle (announcer), and [[person|gerald-mohr|Gerald Mohr]] (performer).

Across its run, the surviving broadcasts are tied to [[org|org.09b709d4bde5c263|Mutual Broadcasting System]], [[org|org.f2f0561f0ce2ddc5|NBC Radio Network]], and [[org|org.4798d1172deaae2c|Armed Forces Radio Service]].
